svg.title: AstralBeam symbol
svg.desc: Two linked orbit rings crossed by a slanted beam of light.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam symbol construction: - Intent: two overlapping orbit rings (the a/b bowls) interlocked like links of a chain, with a tapered shaft of light passing through them at a gentle 22-degree slant. - Reusable ids: #astralbeam-mark, #astralbeam-rings, and #astralbeam-beam. - Design grid: rings are stroked ellipses (centerline rx 30 / ry 34, stroke 12) centered at x = -32 and x = +32. The left ring has an arc gap (+/-32 degrees around its right tip) so the right ring reads as passing over it. - The beam is a spindle (tapered at both tips) rotated 22 degrees, drawn above the rings. - Keep logo colors aligned with the theme values in packages/ui/src/styles.css: rings use currentColor (default: light theme foreground), and the beam uses --astralbeam-primary with the light theme primary as its fallback. - The default color #07191d is the sRGB hex of --foreground oklch(0.200064 0.025239 213.919); the beam fill #0c7a69 is the sRGB hex of --primary oklch(0.519852 0.092904 178.167). - The PNG exporter (librsvg) cannot parse oklch(), so the hex values are embedded. If either theme token changes, recompute its sRGB hex.
